summary: The sponsor-delegated programme selection is recorded in ADR-0093 from public .github#4517 comment 6199911781. It applies only to the single original .103 authentication-only operation. Programme owns policy/change control, EHotwagner retains credential/App custody and SystemAdmin owns the proposed external service and host evidence. A programme-controlled descriptor issuer and separately enrolled distinct ACK authority bind original identities, exact phase bytes, store generation and original-clock observations; App signing and reporter transport do not supply descriptor authority. Preserve one-use gates with durable write/barrier/independent readback, original same-token HTTP 204 revocation, accepted whole-job/runner/VM loss Unknown/unqualified/unretried outcomes and fixed 270/285/300-second bounds with authenticated finite clock uncertainty. Prospectively retain nonsecret facts at most six phase records/64 KiB until 90 days after the original total cutoff; overflow refuses and expiry yields RetentionExpired/Unknown without releasing holds. This phase retention is newly selected, separate from CI artifact retention. The exact 17,647-byte restricted proposal is unavailable in the programme environment; its internal signing/transport topology remains unreconciled. The provider's publisher-path binding needs a reviewed descriptor extension distinguishing original publisher provenance from executing authentication identity and preserving original pins. SystemAdmin owes endpoint/store/transport, enrolled identities, durable ACK and clock/loss evidence; the UTEL source owner owes the extension and compatibility. Inert source is not native acceptance. Separate bounded source reservation and later installed/native admission remain required. All six native selections and all admission/effect flags remain false; original .103 tag remains attempted-unknown and unreplayed, .104 release held. The policy admits no credential issuance, installation, dispatch, journal, tag or release effect.
title: Original .103 authentication domain policy is selected; implementation and effects stay held
